title: Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs
abstract: arXiv:2610.37733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. translated_title: 用于地下水位异常预测的选择性迁移学习：精度-风险权衡
translated_abstract: 本研究针对荷兰多井地下水位异常预测，研究情境感知的选择性迁移学习。源域预训练虽然可以提升平均精度，但并非普遍可靠：它会降低相当一部分异质性井的性能。情境感知选择性学习（CASL）通过经过校准训练的、受约束的上下文混合方式，融合冻结的无迁移父模型与固定迁移父模型。全局凸混合使用相同的父模型，但每个随机种子仅使用一个经校准拟合的权重。修正后的任务要求九个连续观测的月度输入以及精确的三个月历月目标，且不使用插值。评估涵盖457口井、13,718个测试窗口，采用五个预定义随机种子，源池使用四格maxsim0.60并仅依据Always-TL验证RMSE进行冻结。固定迁移损害了18.38%至51.86%的井。CASL的RMSE比无迁移方法低0.424%至1.084%，部分挽救了97.53%至99.50%的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出情境感知选择性学习（CASL），通过校准训练的受约束上下文混合来融合无迁移与固定迁移父模型，在荷兰457口井的地下水位异常预测中实现比无迁移更低的RMSE，并部分挽救被固定迁移损害的绝大多数异质性井，从而揭示迁移学习中的精度-风险权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL), which blends frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parent models through calibration-trained constrained contextual blending, achieving lower RMSE than no transfer in groundwater level anomaly forecasting across 457 Dutch wells while partially rescuing the vast majority of heterogeneous wells harmed by fixed transfer, thereby revealing the accuracy-risk trade-offs of transfer learning.
